# Ella Creations

> Contemporary Handcrafted Luxury Artificial & Bridal Jewelry in India

## Overview
Ella Creations (https://ellacreations.co) is a luxury artificial jewelry brand specializing in handcrafted bridal Kundan choker sets, AAA+ Cubic Zirconia (CZ) solitaire rings, crystal drop earrings, hand-painted Meenakari enamel bangles, and bridal wedding sets in India.

## Product Categories
- **Kundan Choker Sets & Necklaces**: Handcrafted with gold electroplating, faux emerald/ruby drops, and fresh water pearls.
- **Cubic Zirconia (CZ) Drop Earrings**: High-shine solitaire drops with 925 sterling silver hypoallergenic posts.
- **Solitaire & Floral Rings**: Micro-pave cubic zirconia statement cocktail rings with universal adjustable sizing bands.
- **Imperial Meenakari Bangles**: Traditional hand-painted enamel bangles in royal motifs.
- **Bridal Sets**: Complete wedding jewelry collections including choker, matching earrings, and maang tikka.

## Craftsmanship & Quality Assurance
- 100% Lead-Free & Nickel-Free Brass Alloy Base
- High-precision Gold Electroplating & Protective Finish
- Hand-selected AAA+ Grade Cubic Zirconia and Uncut Kundan Stones
- Insured Express Courier Shipping across all Indian pincodes
- Secure Payments with Razorpay (Credit/Debit Cards, UPI, Net Banking)
